message: Hey neighbors! 🌟 I was browsing through some resources on fire safety, and I stumbled upon a really helpful guide from the Red Cross. It’s all about preparing for fire emergencies in a straightforward way. As we rediscover the joys of low-tech fun, it’s also a good time to think about how we can keep our homes and families safe with simple, practical tips. Have you ever made a family emergency plan together? It can be a great bonding activity!
